metadata.title: Public offer - SmartCode Academy
metadata.description: Public offer and terms of service for SmartCode Academy

oferta.title: Public offer
oferta.subtitle: Public offer agreement for educational services

paragraphs.0: This document is a public offer (the "Offer") for the provision of educational services in programming and information technology (the "Services") in accordance with Articles 633, 641, and 642 of the Civil Code of Ukraine.
paragraphs.1: Provider: SmartCode Academy (the "Provider") offers programming education through online lessons and training courses.
paragraphs.2: Acceptance of this Offer occurs when the Customer pays for the Services, which constitutes full agreement with the terms of this Offer.
paragraphs.3: IMPORTANT: SmartCode Academy serves students aged 8–17. All purchases, contracts, and payment obligations are entered into by a parent or legal guardian acting as the Customer. Minors may not complete purchases on this website.

2.title: 2. Subject of the agreement
2.intro: The Provider undertakes to provide the Customer with educational services in the form of:

onlineLessons.title: Online programming lessons
onlineLessons.text: individual sessions conducted in real time over the internet

courses.title: Training courses
courses.text: structured learning programs with a defined duration and curriculum, including:

sublist.4: Other courses listed on the website

materials.title: Additional materials
materials.text: learning materials, assignments, projects, and access to the learning platform

items.0: The Customer selects a course or learning format on smartcode-academy.com
items.1: The Customer pays for the services using one of the available payment methods
items.2: After payment confirmation, the Provider grants the Customer access to learning materials and the learning platform
items.3: Online lessons are conducted according to a pre-agreed schedule
items.4: Access to learning materials is granted for the period specified in the course description

items.0: Course duration is specified in the description of each course on the website
items.1: Online lessons are conducted according to a schedule agreed between the Customer and the Provider
items.2: Access to learning materials is granted from payment confirmation until course completion

payment.title: 3.3. Payment methods
payment.intro: The Customer may pay using the following methods:

wayforpay.title: Online payment via WayForPay
wayforpay.text: Visa and Mastercard bank cards through the WayForPay payment gateway

appleGoogle.title: Apple Pay and Google Pay
appleGoogle.text: available through the WayForPay checkout where supported by the Customer's device and card issuer

payment.note: Payment is made in US dollars (USD) on the English version of the website. Prices for each course or lesson format are displayed on the relevant checkout pages before payment.

delivery.title: 3.4. Service delivery and coverage
delivery.text: Services are provided electronically only — there is no physical shipping of goods. After payment is confirmed, access to the learning platform and course materials is granted online. Live lessons are delivered in real time via Zoom (or another agreed video platform) at a schedule agreed with the Provider.

items.0: Service regions: worldwide, wherever the Customer has a stable internet connection
items.1: Self-paced video courses: access via smartcode-academy.com learning platform
items.2: Live online lessons: conducted remotely via Zoom; no in-person classes unless separately agreed in writing
items.3: Typical access activation time: within 24 hours of successful payment confirmation

absences.title: 3.5. Missed lessons
absences.text: If the Customer misses two (2) scheduled lessons without prior notice to the Provider (in the manner agreed between the parties, including via messenger or email), payment for those missed lessons is deducted from the Customer's prepaid balance and is non-refundable, as the instructor's time was reserved for those sessions.

conditions.title: 4.1. Refund conditions
conditions.intro: The Customer may cancel services and receive a refund in the following cases:

beforeStart.title: Before services begin
beforeStart.text: full refund if cancellation occurs before access to the course or before the first lesson

14days.title: Within the first 14 days
14days.text: after payment and access — full refund if services do not match the stated quality or description

technical.title: Technical issues
technical.text: refund if services cannot be provided due to the Provider's fault (technical failures, platform unavailability, etc.)

items.0: The Customer sends a written refund request to the Provider's email address stating the reason for the refund
items.1: The Provider reviews the request within 5 (five) business days
items.2: If approved, funds are refunded to the same payment method used within 14 (fourteen) business days
items.3: For bank transfer refunds, the Customer provides bank details for the refund

noRefund.title: 4.3. Cases where refunds are not provided

items.0: If the Customer has accessed more than 30% of the course learning materials or attended more than 30% of scheduled lessons
items.1: If more than 14 days have passed since payment and services were fully provided
items.2: If cancellation is due to the Customer's personal circumstances unrelated to service quality
items.3: If the Customer violated the platform or learning materials usage rules

cancellation.title: 4.4. Transaction cancellation
cancellation.text: Transaction cancellation is possible in the cases described above or by mutual agreement. In case of technical payment errors, the Provider undertakes to resolve transaction cancellation as quickly as possible.

companyName.label: Full legal name:

6.title: 6. Rights and obligations of the parties

items.0: Provide services in accordance with this Offer and the website description
items.1: Ensure access to learning materials and the learning platform
items.2: Conduct online lessons according to the agreed schedule
items.3: Maintain confidentiality of the Customer's personal data
items.4: May change the lesson schedule with prior notice to the Customer
items.5: May refuse to provide services if the Customer violates platform usage terms

items.0: Pay for services on time according to the selected course
items.1: Comply with the learning platform and materials usage rules
items.2: Not distribute learning materials to third parties without the Provider's permission
items.3: Provide accurate information during registration and ordering
items.4: Has the right to receive services according to the selected course
items.5: Has the right to cancel services according to the refund terms

items.0: The Provider is not liable for inability to provide services due to the Customer's internet connection or equipment issues
items.1: The Provider is not liable for learning outcomes that depend on the Customer's individual abilities and effort
items.2: The Customer is responsible for keeping their platform login credentials confidential
items.3: If the Customer violates platform usage terms, the Provider may terminate services without a refund

paragraphs.0: The Provider may amend this Offer. The new version takes effect upon publication on smartcode-academy.com.
paragraphs.1: A Customer who continues using services after changes are made is deemed to have accepted the new Offer terms.

9.title: 9. Dispute resolution
9.text: All disputes between the parties shall be resolved through negotiation. If agreement cannot be reached, disputes shall be resolved in accordance with the laws of Ukraine through the courts.

paragraphs.0: This Offer takes effect upon publication on the website and remains in force until withdrawn by the Provider.
paragraphs.1: By accepting this Offer, the Customer confirms full familiarity and agreement with all service terms stated herein.

paragraphs.0: The Provider undertakes to comply with the Law of Ukraine "On Personal Data Protection" and not to disclose the Customer's personal data to third parties without consent, except as required by Ukrainian law.
paragraphs.1: Detailed information on personal data processing is provided in the Privacy Policy published on the website.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How SmartCode Academy collects, uses, and protects personal data

paragraphs.0: This Privacy Policy explains how SmartCode Academy (the "Provider", "we", "us") processes personal data when you use smartcode-academy.com, our learning platform, and related educational services.
paragraphs.1: This Policy applies to parents and legal guardians who register or pay on behalf of students, to adult students where applicable, and to visitors who submit inquiries through our website.
paragraphs.2: We process personal data in accordance with the Law of Ukraine "On Personal Data Protection" and, where applicable, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) for international customers.

paragraphs.0: The data controller is the legal entity or sole proprietor identified in the Public Offer and in the Seller contact information section at the end of this Policy.
paragraphs.1: For privacy-related requests, contact us at the email address listed in the Seller contact information section.

0.title: Account and profile data
0.text: name, email address, phone number, login credentials, course enrollments, and learning progress

1.title: Payment-related data
1.text: transaction identifiers, payment amount, currency, and payment status — card numbers and CVV are processed only by WayForPay and are not stored on our servers

2.title: Student data
2.text: student name, age or grade level where provided, assignments, quiz results, and platform activity — collected with parental consent for minors

3.title: Technical data
3.text: IP address, browser type, device information, cookies, and analytics events used to secure and improve the service

4.title: Communications
4.text: messages sent to support, feedback forms, and scheduling information for live lessons

4.title: 4. Purposes and legal bases of processing

0.title: Contract performance
0.text: to provide courses, platform access, live lessons, certificates, and customer support

1.title: Payment processing
1.text: to process purchases through WayForPay and prevent fraud

2.title: Legitimate interests
2.text: to improve our platform, ensure security, and send service-related notifications

3.title: Legal obligations
3.text: to comply with tax, accounting, and regulatory requirements

4.title: Consent
4.text: for optional marketing communications and non-essential cookies, where required

paragraphs.0: We do not sell personal data. We share data only with trusted processors necessary to operate our services:
paragraphs.1: WayForPay — payment processing (Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay); MongoDB Atlas or equivalent — database hosting; Vercel or equivalent — website hosting; Zoom — live online lessons; email and analytics providers — as configured for our operations.
paragraphs.2: Processors are required to protect data under contractual obligations. We may disclose data if required by law or to protect our legal rights.

paragraphs.0: Some processors may store or process data outside Ukraine or the European Economic Area. Where required, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses or equivalent mechanisms.
We retain account and course data for as long as your account is active and for a reasonable period thereafter to comply with legal obligations and resolve disputes.
paragraphs.1: Payment records are retained as required by tax and accounting law (typically at least 3 years unless a longer period is mandated).
paragraphs.2: You may request deletion of data that is no longer required, subject to legal retention limits.

paragraphs.0: We use encryption (HTTPS), access controls, and secure authentication to protect personal data. Payment card data is handled exclusively by WayForPay in PCI-DSS compliant infrastructure.
paragraphs.1: No method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure; we encourage strong passwords and prompt reporting of suspected unauthorized access.

paragraphs.0: Our services are designed for students aged 8–17. We collect student information only with verifiable parental or guardian consent and limit collection to what is necessary for education.
paragraphs.1: Parents and guardians may review, correct, or request deletion of their child's personal data by contacting us, subject to legal exceptions.

paragraphs.0: We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. Analytics cookies may be used to understand how visitors use our site; you can control non-essential cookies through your browser settings.
paragraphs.1: Third-party payment and video platforms may set their own cookies when you use their services.

11.title: 11. Your rights

0.title: Access
0.text: request a copy of personal data we hold about you

2.title: Erasure
2.text: request deletion where there is no overriding legal basis to retain data

3.title: Restriction and objection
3.text: restrict or object to certain processing based on legitimate interests

4.title: Data portability
4.text: receive data you provided in a structured, commonly used format where applicable

5.title: Complaint
5.text: lodge a complaint with the Ukrainian Commissioner for Human Rights or your local supervisory authority

11.text: We respond to verified requests within 30 calendar days unless a longer period is permitted by law.

paragraphs.0: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The current version is always published on this page with an updated date.
paragraphs.1: Continued use of our services after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.subtitle: Conditions and procedure for refunds and transaction cancellation

paragraphs.0: At SmartCode Academy we aim for your complete satisfaction with our educational services. This Refund Policy describes when and how you may request a refund or cancel a payment transaction.
paragraphs.1: This Policy supplements Section 4 of our Public Offer. In case of conflict, the Public Offer prevails for contractual matters; this page provides a clear summary for customers and payment partners.

0.title: Before services begin
0.text: 100% refund if you cancel at least 24 hours before the first live lesson or before accessing self-paced course materials

1.title: Within 14 days of purchase
1.text: full refund if the service materially does not match the description on the website (subject to verification)

2.title: Provider technical failure
2.text: full or proportional refund if we cannot provide access or lessons due to platform outage or our fault

3.title: Interrupted live lessons
3.text: proportional refund for unused prepaid live lessons if you stop studying after the course has started

4.title: Self-paced video courses
4.text: refund within 14 days of purchase if less than 20% of course content has been viewed or completed

0.title: Substantial use
0.text: no refund if more than 30% of course materials were accessed or more than 30% of scheduled live lessons were attended

1.title: Late cancellation
1.text: no refund for missed live lessons without at least 24 hours prior notice — the instructor's time was reserved (see Public Offer §3.5)

2.title: Personal reasons
2.text: no refund solely due to change of mind after the 14-day period or after substantial use, unless required by mandatory law

3.title: Terms violation
3.text: no refund if access was terminated due to violation of platform rules or misuse of learning materials

items.0: Send a written request to our support email (see Seller contact information below) with your full name, order reference or payment date, course name, and reason for the refund
items.1: We acknowledge requests within 2 business days and review them within 5 business days
items.2: If approved, the refund is processed to the original payment method within 14 business days
items.3: For card payments via WayForPay, refunds appear on your statement according to your bank's processing time (typically 5–10 business days after we initiate the refund)

paragraphs.0: If a payment was made in error (duplicate charge, wrong amount), contact us immediately. We will cancel or refund erroneous transactions as quickly as possible.
paragraphs.1: Chargebacks should be a last resort — please contact us first so we can resolve the issue directly.

paragraphs.0: Educational services are digital services delivered online. By purchasing, you acknowledge that delivery begins upon granting platform access or scheduling live lessons.
paragraphs.1: Where applicable law grants a cooling-off period for distance contracts, your statutory rights remain unaffected by this Policy.
